slots.notes: Fullscreen autoplaying muted looping hero background video, absolute inset-0 w-full h-full object-fill behind the entire navbar/headline/trusted-by stack. object-fill stretches edge-to-edge with no cropping and no overlay, so the source should read well when distorted to the viewport aspect.

mechanic: A 100vh full-viewport hero with a fullscreen object-fill looping background video behind a z-10 flex column holding the navbar, a vertically centered gradient-clipped headline with a corner-notched CTA button, and a low-opacity trusted-by brand row.
techDelivery: React + Tailwind CSS + TypeScript, fonts Akshar and Inter loaded via Google Fonts <link> in index.html; colors as HSL-triplet CSS custom properties with a heading-gradient utility using background-clip:text.
reskinNotes: Colors are declared as raw HSL triplets in CSS custom properties (e.g. --primary: 212 72% 18%), so reskinning means editing the triplets, not hex; the headline color is a background-clip:text linear-gradient driven by --heading-gradient-from/--heading-gradient-to (mapped here to accent/accent2), so retinting the headline requires editing those two gradient stops rather than fg. The layout assumes a light --background with dark --foreground text directly over the video (no scrim), so a dark brand video can render text unreadable. Logo (NEXUS), nav labels (HOME/SOLUTIONS/OUR TEAM/NEWS), headline, subheading, CTA labels and the trusted-by brand names (FedEx/amazon/McKESSON/pitney bowes) are all hardcoded in JSX. Headline uses a tight letterSpacing of -0.06em and the Akshar font, so copy length and wrapping at max-w-3xl are font-metric-load-bearing; the CTA is a NotchedButton whose 8 corner-decoration spans (10px x 1px, inset 4px) are CSS, not assets.
